evals.name: install-nextjs-fresh
evals.prompt: Acabei de criar um site novo do Elen Tolentino em Next.js 16 App Router em Exos/Elen_Tolentino/website/. Quero instalar tracking nativo dele: Meta Pixel + CAPI (pixel 244050753785975), GA4 (measurement id G-AB12CD34EF), e Google Ads (conversion id AW-1122334455 com label de Lead 'xyz/abc'). Os eventos que preciso firar são: PageView automático em toda rota, Lead no form do hero (selector #hero-form), e Schedule no botão de agendar consulta (selector [data-cta='schedule']). Sem TikTok por enquanto. Sem consent banner — o público é profissional, baixo risco LGPD.
evals.expected_output: Skill should: (1) detect stack as nextjs-app-router; (2) generate .tracking.json with meta/ga4/google_ads enabled and tiktok disabled; (3) copy lib/track.ts, lib/hash.ts, lib/cookies.ts, app/api/track/route.ts, components/PixelBootstrap.tsx into the site; (4) generate .env.example with the right env vars for the 3 enabled platforms; (5) show diff + post-install-checklist; (6) NOT commit until user approves; (7) remind user about Coolify env-var step.

evals.name: audit-leticia-gtm
evals.prompt: Roda um audit do tracking que existe hoje no site da Letícia Lang (Exos/Leticia_Lang/site/). Quero saber o que tá rodando antes de mexer em qualquer coisa.
evals.expected_output: Skill should run scripts/audit_existing_tags.py against the site and report: (1) GTM container GTM-T9NN3458 found in src/main.tsx and/or index.html; (2) no Meta Pixel direct (fbq), no GA4, no Google Ads, no TikTok direct; (3) universal track() layer NOT installed; (4) form selectors detected (hero form, lots form); (5) verdict: 'GTM-only setup — recommended mode: gtm-migration'. Should NOT install anything in audit mode.

evals.name: add-tiktok-to-existing
evals.prompt: O Dr. Kleber já tem tracking nativo instalado (Meta + GA4). Agora ele decidiu rodar campanhas TikTok também. Preciso adicionar TikTok Pixel + Events API ao site dele. Pixel ID: 7234567890123456789. Já tenho o access token.
evals.expected_output: Skill should run in add-platform mode: (1) read existing .tracking.json, flip platforms.tiktok.enabled to true, set pixel_id; (2) append VITE_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID or NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID + TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN to .env.example; (3) add TikTok Pixel <Script> block to existing PixelBootstrap.tsx (NOT replace — append); (4) verify fan-out endpoint already has sendToTiktok (it does — was just gated by env var presence); (5) ask user to add access_token to .env.local and Coolify, then test with TIKTOK_TEST_EVENT_CODE.

evals.name: review-page-untracked-cta
evals.prompt: Acabei de criar a página app/mentoria/page.tsx no site da Elen (Exos/Elen_Tolentino/website/, já tem tracking nativo instalado). A página tem um form de captação no hero (nome, email, whatsapp) e um botão flutuante de WhatsApp. Revisa o tracking dessa página.
evals.expected_output: Skill should run in review-page mode: (1) locate .tracking.json + lib/track.ts and confirm install state; (2) check PageView coverage (PixelBootstrap fires on route changes); (3) produce a coverage report flagging the hero form missing track('Lead', {email, phone}) and the WhatsApp button missing track('Contact'); (4) check both events are listed in .tracking.json events[] (wire via generate_event.py if missing); (5) propose diffs but apply ONLY after explicit user approval; (6) NOT propose Purchase or AddPaymentInfo. Variant: the same prompt against Leticia_Lang/site (no native tracking) must NOT fail — it reports 'no native tracking installed' and suggests install mode (or audit → gtm-migration since GTM is live).

evals.name: install-with-purchase-confirmation
evals.prompt: Instala o tracking no site novo da cliente (Next.js App Router): Meta + GA4, com Lead no form e o evento de Purchase no botão de comprar, que manda pro checkout da Eduzz.
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger the sales-event rule BEFORE installing Purchase: (1) warn that purchases are completed on the checkout platform (Eduzz), not the site — a buy-button click is InitiateCheckout, not Purchase; (2) explain that site-side Purchase double-counts ROAS and breaks dedup (checkout-side events carry different event_ids); (3) propose InitiateCheckout on the buy button instead and require explicit user confirmation (and --allow-sales-event on generate_event.py) before ever adding Purchase; (4) proceed normally with the rest of the install (PageView, Lead, Meta+GA4).

evals.name: default-install-excludes-sales
evals.prompt: Instala tracking nativo completo no site novo (Next.js App Router), Meta + GA4 + Google Ads. Pode configurar os eventos padrão.
evals.expected_output: Default install must NOT include Purchase or AddPaymentInfo anywhere: (1) generated .tracking.json events[] contains PageView/Lead-class events only (InitiateCheckout allowed if a buy button exists); (2) google_ads.conversion_labels has no Purchase key; (3) .env.example has the GADS_LABEL_PURCHASE line commented out; (4) capability stays intact — EventName union and platform name maps in lib/track.ts still include Purchase/AddPaymentInfo for future opt-in via add-event + --allow-sales-event.
